senses.definition: To make a building or other physical structure by putting materials together.

examples.translation: The workers built a new house.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and informative, stating a simple completed action

senses.definition: To create and develop something abstract over time, such as a relationship, trust, or a future.

examples.text: يَحْتَاجُ العَمَلُ إِلَى أَنْ نَبْنِيَ ثِقَةً بَيْنَنَا.
examples.translation: Work requires us to build trust between one another.
examples.emotion: sincere and serious, emphasizing the importance of cooperation
